title: Agentic Data Security Firm Sentra Raises $150 Million
description: Sentra, an agentic data security firm, announced raising $150 million in Series C funding to enhance its AI-powered data security platform. The platform protects data across cloud, SaaS, data warehouses, and on-premises environments by enforcing least privilege policies and flagging unusual access. The company aims to accelerate agentic data security capabilities, provide visibility into AI data access, and expand its market presence. This announcement is a funding and business update rather than a security threat or vulnerability.
